questions: 1. Have you noticed any stiffness or slowness in your right arm or leg recently? 2. Do you have a tremor in your right hand when it's resting?
1. Have you experienced any difficulties with your balance or had any recent falls? 2. Do you feel unsteady when walking, especially in the dark or on uneven surfaces?

1. Have you noticed any changes in your memory or thinking recently? 2. Have you had any problems with bladder control or needing to urinate frequently? 3. Have you noticed any problems with your vision or eye movements?

1. Do you have double vision or difficulty looking up or down? 2. Do you feel like your feet are stuck to the floor when you try to walk? 3. How long have these balance and memory problems been getting worse - weeks, months, or years?

1. Do you have any family members with similar balance or walking problems? 2. Have you noticed any changes in your speech, such as slurring or becoming harder to understand? 3. How much alcohol do you typically drink in a week?

1. Are your balance problems worse when people are watching you compared to when you're alone? 2. Do the symptoms improve when you are distracted or not paying attention to them? 3. Have you ever had a similar episode before?
